title: PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Training Note: Payment Habits and the Activation Cover Days
content:
**Rule.** For the activation payment of PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering), where the latest payment to the enrolled service account came by mailed check, office check or money order and at least 2 payments in the three-month window came by those channels, the cover days are 14; where the latest payment came in cash at an office or at a payment kiosk and at least 2 payments in the three-month window came by those channels, the cover days are 10. With any other payment record the payment record does not change the cover days. Any increase of the cover days is added to the cover days the payment record sets.

The payments are those of the enrolled service account on Electric Service by Rate Schedule: the channel of its latest payment and the channels of its payments in the three-month window. A month window of a stated number of months covers the records dated after the same day of the month that many months before the current date, up to and including the current date.

### Questions answered

**Latest payment by money order; one other mailed check in the three-month window.** Two payments by mailed check, office check or money order in the window, the latest among them: the cover days are 14. Mailed checks, office checks and money orders count together toward the 2.

**Latest payment in cash at a district office; one earlier kiosk payment in the window.** Cash at an office and payment kiosk count together: two such payments, the latest among them, so the cover days are 10.

**Latest payment by mailed check, but it is the only check-type payment in the window; two kiosk payments came earlier.** The latest payment is check-type but only one check-type payment lies in the window, and the latest is not a cash or kiosk payment: the payment record does not change the cover days.

**Latest payment online by card after two office checks.** The latest payment decides the group, and online card belongs to neither group: the payment record does not change the cover days.

| Latest payment | Payments of the same group in the three-month window | Cover days from the payment record |
|---|---|---|
| mailed check, office check or money order | 2 or more | 14 |
| cash at an office or payment kiosk | 2 or more | 10 |
| either group | fewer than 2 | unchanged |
| any other channel | any | unchanged |
